title: Grader Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Grader standalone module.

verdict.description: Grader verdict on the primary output against the spec

score.description: Quality score of primary output against spec. See schemas/grade-score.schema.json for scale.

score_rationale.description: One sentence explaining the score. Must reference the spec artifact, not aesthetics.

spec_artifact_path.description: Path to the ground truth spec used for evaluation

adversary_receipt_path.description: Path to the adversary-receipt.json used as input. Grader must not be invoked without this.

revision_guidance.description: Required when verdict = REVISE. null otherwise. Must be specific and actionable per rules/revision-guidance.md.

escalation_reason.description: Required when verdict = ESCALATE. null otherwise. States what requires human judgment.

adversary_concerns_assessed.description: Total number of Adversary challenge points evaluated

adversary_concerns_within_scope.description: Number of Adversary points within current spec scope. Must be ≤ adversary_concerns_assessed.
